title: Week 2: Ownership, Environment & Terminal Editing
description: Session II: System Customization and Control. Master ownership management (chown, chgrp, recursive -R), explore core environment variables ($USER, $HOME, $SHELL, $PATH), export and persist system variables in ~/.bashrc, extend the global executable search path, and navigate terminal text editing in Nano and Vim modal editing (:wq, :q!, dd, u). Verified by IITM Jarvis Linux Club.
